Medical Administrative Assistant Job at Zinance Limited




        
    

        
        Zinance Limited is a dynamic Information Technology and Consulting firm committed to delivering innovative digital solutions and strategic advisory services to businesses of all sizes.
We combine technical expertise with industry insight to help organizations improve performance, streamline operations, and achieve sustainable growth.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Medical Administrative Assistant 

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time

Description
     

            
    




	We are looking for a Medical administrative assistant to organize our medical facility’s functions. You will support day-to-day operations by performing administrative tasks and ensuring high quality customer service for our patients.


Responsibilities


	Interview patients for case histories prior to appointments
	Update and maintain patients’ health records
	Assist patients with initial paperwork
	Schedule and coordinate appointments
	Process insurance claims in compliance with law requirements
	Use medical software to support all transactions
	Manage receivable and payable accounts and maintain financial records
	Answer patients’ queries and ensure quality customer service
	Collaborate with doctors and nurses to help with medical examinations, schedule tests and order supplies
	Ensure compliance with procedures
	Keep up-to-date with changes in medical and insurance legislation


Requirements and skills


	Hands on experience with medical software and MS Office
	Knowledge of healthcare operations
	Familiarity with medical and insurance legislation
	Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
	Customer-oriented communication skills


Salary
N130,000 - N200,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified canddiates should forward their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.     

    

        Click here to Apply

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Office Assistant

Job Location: Marina, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Facilities and Administrative
Reports To: Facilities and Administrative Supervisor

Job Summary


	The Office Assistant will support daily office operations and assist with administrative tasks and errands.
	The ideal candidate should be proactive, trustworthy, and willing to support the team as needed.


Key Responsibilities


	Provide general administrative support in the office.
	Helping organize and maintain cleanliness of the office common areas.
	Manage office supplies, ensuring inventory is adequately stocked and organized.
	Run office and business-related errands when required
	Coordinating events as necessary.
	Handle general office duties to support management and staff.
	Perform other duties as assigned by management.


Requirements


	Candidates should possess minimum of SSCE/OND or its equivalent.
	Previous experience in an office support or messenger role is an advantage.
	Honest, reliable, and physically fit for errands
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Basic knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, Email).
	Must be based in or near Lagos Island (or willing to commute).


Salary

  "title": "Transport Supervisor",
  "description": "ResumeSurge - We connect ambitious businesses with exceptional talent. We are a forward-thinking&nbsp;&nbsp;recruitment consultancy dedicated to helping companies find the right people to drive their success &mdash; and helping skilled professionals find the right opportunities to advance their careers.&nbsp;

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Transport Supervisor

Job Location: Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Transport &amp; Logistics
Reports To: Head of Transport

Job Purpose


	The Transport Supervisor is responsible for coordinating, supervising, and optimizing daily&nbsp;&nbsp;transportation operations across assigned locations.
	The role ensures the safe, efficient, and cost-effective movement of personnel, materials, and operational resources while maintaining high standards of fleet availability, driver performance, regulatory compliance, and health, safety, and environmental (HSE) performance.
	The position oversees drivers, fleet operations, dispatch activities, fuel management, vehicle maintenance coordination, and transport performance monitoring to ensure seamless transportation service delivery.


Key Responsibilities
Transport Operations Management:


	Coordinate and supervise the daily dispatch of company vehicles in accordance with approved transport requests.
	Ensure journey plans are validated and approved before execution.
	Monitor fleet positioning, vehicle utilization, and availability in real time.
	Resolve operational challenges and escalate critical issues where necessary.
	Ensure effective deployment of staff buses, pool vehicles, and operational vehicles to support business requirements.


Driver Supervision &amp; Workforce Management:


	Supervise company and contractor drivers and dispatch personnel.
	Develop driver schedules, shift rosters, and rotation plans.
	Monitor attendance, punctuality, discipline, and overall performance.
	Enforce company driving standards, transport procedures, and code of conduct.
	Conduct driver briefings, coaching sessions, and performance reviews.
	Address employee welfare issues and maintain a positive working environment.


Health, Safety &amp; Environment (HSE):


	Promote and maintain a strong safety culture across all transport operations.
	Ensure compliance with defensive driving standards and journey management procedures.
	Enforce speed management and fatigue management policies.
	Conduct toolbox talks, safety briefings, and transport safety inspections.
	Participate in the investigation of transport incidents and accidents.
	Implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize risks and improve safety performance.
	Ensure the safety of personnel, assets, goods, and other road users.


Fleet Performance &amp; Monitoring:


	Monitor driver behavior using telematics and fleet management systems.
	Analyze vehicle utilization, route efficiency, and operational performance.
	Track vehicle downtime and ensure timely resolution of maintenance-related issues.
	Support route optimization and effective vehicle allocation.
	Identify opportunities to improve fleet productivity and operational efficiency.


Vehicle Maintenance &amp; Asset Management:&nbsp;


	Ensure completion of pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections.
	Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities with workshops and service providers.
	Monitor vehicle condition, roadworthiness, and compliance with maintenance schedules.
	Identify recurring mechanical issues and recommend appropriate corrective measures.
	Support the implementation and maintenance of fleet monitoring systems including IVMS and related technologies.


Fuel Management &amp; Cost Control:


	Monitor fuel issuance, consumption, and utilization trends.
	Identify fuel-related anomalies, inefficiencies, and potential misuse.
	Promote fuel-efficient driving practices across the fleet.
	Support fuel inventory control and reporting processes.
	Contribute to budget management and cost optimization initiatives within transport operations.


Reporting &amp; Documentation:


	Maintain accurate records of vehicle utilization, driver performance, fuel consumption, and maintenance activities.
	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly transport operations reports.
	Report operational risks, safety concerns, and performance gaps to management.
	Maintain transport documentation and ensure compliance with company requirements.
	Perform any additional duties assigned by management.


Key Accountabilities:


	Safe and efficient transport operations across assigned locations.
	High fleet availability and utilization.
	Effective supervision and management of drivers and transport personnel.
	Compliance with journey management and road safety requirements.
	Effective fuel administration and transport cost control.
	Timely maintenance and operational readiness of fleet assets.
	Continuous improvement in transport safety and service performance.


HSE Responsibilities:


	Comply with all company HSE policies, procedures, and standards.
	Report incidents, unsafe conditions, and hazardous practices promptly.
	Participate actively in HSE meetings, drills, and safety initiatives.
	Promote safe work practices and a zero-incident culture.


Qualifications
Education:


	
	HND or Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Transport Management, Logistics, Engineering, Social Sciences, Management Sciences, or a related discipline.&nbsp;

	CalculatingFreight Shipping Rates
	


Experience:


	Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in transport, logistics, fleet&nbsp;management, or general services within a large organization.
	At least five (5) years of relevant experience in logistics, engineering, transportation, or a related operational environment.
	Experience supervising drivers, fleet operations, and transport contractors is desirable.


Technical Competencies:


	Fleet&nbsp;Management
	Transportation Operations
	Journey Management Systems
	Vehicle Dispatch Coordination
	Driver Performance Management
	Telematics and IVMS Monitoring
	Fuel Management and Control
	Fleet Maintenance Coordination
	Route Planning and Optimization
	Incident Investigation
	Operational Reporting and Analytics
	Budget Monitoring and Cost Control
	Microsoft Office Applications


Behavioral Competencies:


	Strong leadership and supervisory skills.
	Sound judgment and decision-making ability.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
	Excellent organizational and administrative skills.
	Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
	Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and&nbsp;manage multiple priorities.
	Attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.
	Patience, professionalism, and strong stakeholder management skills.
